notes: Normalized from a DARK monochromatic-purple profile. Two near-black indigos run the page: outermost bg #150f23 (raw rgb(21,15,35), the dominant backgroundColor) and section/panel surface #1f1633 (raw rgb(31,22,51)) — confirmed by sampling hero + footer regions in the screenshot. surface-2 #3c1878 is the one SATURATED royal-purple feature panel (newsletter block; raw rgb(66,32,130)≈#422082, sampled at #3c1878). PRIMARY accent is magenta-pink #ff45b2 (raw rgb(253,68,176)) used for the two-tone headline emphasis word, section subheads, footer column labels and the outline-CTA border; accent-fg is the dark bg, not white, because solid buttons render white with dark text in the hero. accent-violet #7553ff (raw rgb(117,83,255)) is the electric button/highlight fill. The six 'data-*' hues (coral/sky/blue/lavender/lime/green — all from the color frequency list) appear only INSIDE product-UI mocks and the mascot art; they are a charting/illustration palette, NOT general UI accents, so they are namespaced separately to keep them rationed. fg is pure #fff; body grays normalize to muted #d4d4d4 (raw rgb(212,212,212)) → subtle #9298a8 → faint #6a737d (raw rgb(106,115,125)). Borders on dark are white at ~12% (raw rgb(225,228,232) hairlines reading as low-opacity white on the dark field). Type: Rubik is the workhorse geometric sans (16px body dominant, count 2750); 'Dammit Sans' (count 17) is a CUSTOM chunky slab display used ONLY for the closing 'Fix It' CTA block (headline AND its body copy) — a deliberate voice-shift, not a body face. Monaco + IBM Plex Mono carry all code. Display sizes observed at 60px and 88px → top of scale 3.75rem/5.5rem; line-height on display is ~1.1 (60px/66px). radius 3.35544e+07px in the raw profile is the browser's full-pill clamp artifact → normalized to 9999px; 10.6px → 10px. The signature shadow '0 0 8px 6px #150f23' (count 82) is not elevation — it is a same-color glow/vignette feathering product mocks into the dark bg; kept verbatim. Spacing rhythm is an 8px base; large section padding observed at 44px/64px blocks.
